عِنْوٌ sing. of أَعْنَآءٌ as signifying The sides, regions, quarters, or tracts, (S, K,) of a country, (S,) or of the sky; (K;) like أَحْنَآءٌ: (S in art. حنو and حنى:) or, accord. to IAar, its sing., in this sense, is ↓ عِنًا : (S:) and the pl. signifies also the sides of the face. (TA.) ―
-b2- And sing. of أَعْنَآءٌ as signifying A party of men of sundry, or different, tribes. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
